common_rules.precision: 512-bit significand directed balls for every inexact operation; exact integer/rational work has no precision concept and may not be substituted for a second floating precision
common_rules.projection: project the exact midpoint of an enclosed x to the nearest dyadic n*2^-448; ties choose even n; record a directed ball for exact_dyadic-x and let the later proof predicates, not membership of the dyadic in x, decide adequacy
common_rules.ordering: all matrices use canonical row-major wire order; all ties choose the least canonical ordinal
common_rules.parallelism: tasks may execute concurrently only when their input hashes and output ordinals are fixed; persistence is always in ascending ordinal order
common_rules.budget_exhaustion: the first exhausted counter emits builder_budget_exhausted:<role>:<counter>, persists the partial transcript and terminates; no fallback or extension exists
common_rules.verification_separation: a generated certificate is never trusted: the same lane re-evaluates every exact certificate through its directed verifier, and the later cross-language audit replays its wire semantics
common_rules.candidate_ingress_rule: the complete source, builder contract, numeric selector manifest, runtime and executable identities must be immutable before any selected-background byte is read
